list.title: Members
list.search: Search by name, member number or mobile number
list.choose: Choose a member from the list.

form.fullNameHint: Three names are best, e.g. Aram Karim Muhammad.
form.phoneHint: For example 0750 123 4567. Write a number from another country with + and the country code.
form.noOwnPhone: Has no mobile number of their own (e.g. a child)
form.emergencyHint: This member has no number of their own, so a close person's number is needed.
form.referral: How did they hear about the gym?
form.tagsHint: Type a tag and press Enter, e.g. student.
form.healthPrivate: Only staff who are allowed can see this. After saving, you won't see it again yourself.
form.healthShared: Only staff who are allowed can see this.
form.medicalNotesHint: Illnesses, medicines or anything a trainer needs to know.

errors.fullName: Enter the full name. Keep it short enough.
errors.phone: This mobile number is not valid. For example 0750 123 4567, or + and the country code.
errors.phoneRequired: Enter a mobile number, or mark that they have none of their own.
errors.tag: A tag has 1 to 30 characters and can't be added twice.

duplicates.phoneTitle: This number belongs to another member
duplicates.phoneText: Each number belongs to one member only. If it is the same person, open their page.
duplicates.nameTitle: This person may already be registered
duplicates.nameText: These members have a similar name. If it is someone else, you can go on.
duplicates.archived: Archived. Reactivate them instead of registering again.

create.title: New member
create.description: The member number is given automatically. Only the name, gender and mobile number are required.

detail.noPhone: Has no number of their own
detail.referral: How they heard about the gym
detail.notFound: This member was not found, or you can't see them.
detail.healthHidden: This member has health notes. Only staff who are allowed can see them, for example a trainer or a manager.
detail.archivedNotice: This member is archived. Reactivate them first to change their details.

statusActions.title: Member status
statusActions.suspendDescription: They can't come to the gym until they are reactivated. Their details stay as they are.
statusActions.banDescription: They can no longer come to the gym, until a manager reactivates them.
statusActions.archiveDescription: They leave the members list, but their details are never deleted and you can reactivate them later.
statusActions.activateDescription: They can come to the gym again.
